insight: Parent Music AI raised a $40M Series A in 2025 from CAA/NEA's Connect Ventures; Moises serves 70M+ musicians.
name: Moises
tagline: The musician's app: AI stem separation, chord detection, and practice tools.
description: An AI music suite that splits any track into isolated stems (vocals, drums, bass, and more), removes vocals, and detects chords and key. It adds practice-focused tools — pitch and tempo control, a smart metronome, and recording — across web, desktop, and native mobile apps.
edge: Wraps stem separation in real practice tools — chord/key detection, pitch/tempo shift, metronome — not just a splitter.
pros: All-in-one practice suite, not just stems
Chord and key detection built in

references.title: I tested 11 of the best stem separation tools
